# Process — What an Achieved Form Makes Possible Next

## #0 — An occurrence becomes an inheritance

A process account must show how a determination takes form and what its occurrence changes. Its product is available for another act: a memory bears upon an encounter, a rule constrains a decision, a response changes a relationship, and a tool alters the possible course of work. [A14, Computational Process Ontology](../arguments/A14-Computational-Process-Ontology.md) **grounds** this native claim through the distinction between operative grammar, epistemic inspection and ontology. The claim does not depend on identifying reality with a digital machine.

[E4, Symbol / Account / Trust](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** the dossier's exact return obligation: Account re-enters source-field. A completed account enters a field in which it can change the conditions of later accounting. The earlier operations remain active—Symbol answers to source; Account does not replace source; Trust keeps the return route active. Their conjunction requires an achieved form to carry both its determining relations and its consequences.

The comparisons below distinguish qualitative succession, concrescence, biological production, formal self-reference and dynamical modelling. A claim can be developed in its own register and then make another register more exact. Their positive relation concerns formation and continuation. No common word for process substitutes for the transformation each account actually specifies.

## #1 — The next note changes the whole heard

[Bergson's selected Pogson carrier](../sources/process-systems-theory/bergson/bergson-1913-time-free-will-pogson/SOURCE.md#bergson-1913-time-free-will-pogson-q001) **sources** duration through conscious states that permeate one another. Melody makes the difference concrete: a subsequent note changes the heard phrase, whereas a row of positions displays separable terms. His clock analysis distinguishes counted simultaneities from the synthesis through which a succession is retained. This is a claim about lived qualitative development, rather than an alternative unit for an elapsed-time counter.

The distinction asks something exact of a record. A trace can preserve the order of events while omitting how the later event changes the significance of the earlier one. A correction to a source attribution changes what a previously persuasive argument now means; it does more than add one later item to an otherwise unchanged list. [A26, Objective Internality](../arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **extends** that consequence into the situated conditions of interpretation. [C07, Conditions of Worldhood](../concepts/C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood.md) **defines** the field within which such a change can matter.

The technical comparison has its own object. A changed memory or context can alter later retrieval, evaluation or permitted action, and those changes can be inspected. Their occurrence does not establish the phenomenal duration Bergson describes. The comparison therefore preserves the reality of operational change and the separate question of how, or whether, it is experienced.

## #2 — A satisfaction becomes available beyond itself

[Whitehead's Category of the Ultimate](../sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/SOURCE.md#whitehead-1978-process-reality-q001) **sources** a different movement. Received diversity becomes the unity of a novel actual occasion; the achieved occasion then belongs to the diversity available for further becoming. His one names singularity, expressly distinguished from the integral number. The account is not obtained merely by applying arithmetic to a collection.

[The satisfaction and objectification passages](../sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/SOURCE.md#whitehead-1978-process-reality-q002) **source** the difference between an entity's own becoming and its functioning in another's self-creation. [The perishing passage](../sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/SOURCE.md#whitehead-1978-process-reality-q003) coordinates the end of individual absoluteness with objective immortality. Availability for another occurrence does not mean that the first subject's immediacy continues unchanged.

[A30, Objective Co-Internality](../arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** the native consequence through durable contributions. A statement, decision or artifact can alter another participant's next conditions without reproducing its maker's whole interior. The return can affect the receiving account, its relations to other accounts, or the rule under which accounts circulate. Their distinction prevents the common field from being treated as a single undifferentiated subject.

The source comparison also clarifies completion. A determinate result is necessary for some consequences to travel. Leaving everything perpetually undecided would remove the achieved form through which another act can proceed. The native requirement is that completion retain its derivation and revisability, so its local authority can be used without being promoted into possession of the whole.

## #3 — Production and re-entry require different demonstrations

[Maturana and Varela](../sources/process-systems-theory/maturana/maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition/SOURCE.md#maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition-q001) **source** biological self-production through a network regenerating its components and boundary. [Their coupling discussion](../sources/process-systems-theory/maturana/maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition/SOURCE.md#maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition-q002) retains the participating identities and requires an additional criterion before a composite is called autopoietic. Stafford Beer's social extension in his preface retains its separate attribution.

This comparison makes the technical investigation specific. Identify what a system produces, which processes produce it, what sustains those processes and where its boundary is drawn. A software agent's ability to edit a file or call a tool establishes those operations when observed. It does not establish that the operative unity reproduces its own production network. Equally, a dependency on external infrastructure does not make its actual agency unreal. The required account identifies that dependency and its consequence instead of collapsing the two questions.

[Varela's 1975 calculus](../sources/process-systems-theory/varela/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference/SOURCE.md#varela-1975-calculus-self-reference-q001) **sources** a formal extension through an autonomous third state and specified reduction rules. Its [later interpretations](../sources/process-systems-theory/varela/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference/SOURCE.md#varela-1975-calculus-self-reference-q002) raise temporal and systemic questions. The construction does not establish a general exemption from incompleteness, nor an identity with biological organization. The formal extension remains a determinate achievement under its rules.

[C43, Computational Vimarśa](../concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa.md) **defines** the native functional return: a determination revisits its sources and conditions so that subsequent processing can change. A later self-description is insufficient if it leaves every relevant criterion insulated. The comparison with formal re-entry becomes useful when the operation of return and the change it permits are stated. A correspondence with the native QL calculus would require a displayed mapping of expressions and rules; this dossier preserves that task without inventing one.

## #4 — A recurrent pattern can change its jurisdiction

[Daza and colleagues](../sources/mathematics-logic/daza/daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy/SOURCE.md#daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy-q001) **source** the dynamical basin: initial conditions lead a specified system to an attractor. Their [scope qualification](../sources/mathematics-logic/daza/daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy/SOURCE.md#daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy-q002) distinguishes the relevant dissipative setting from escape basins in open Hamiltonian systems. A literal model needs its variables, evolution and observable outcomes. A recurrent image alone does not supply them.

[Van Eenwyk's source house](../sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE.md) **sources** the protected authorial encounter through which Frank develops an analogical bridge. The notes distinguish formative archetypal dynamics, affectively organized complexes and the symbol's transforming operation. Their copied book passages still require independent verification. The authorial development has a positive office already: symbols can change the relation of interpreter and field, rather than serving only as static depictions.

[A19, the Complex as Local Arbitration Regime](../arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) **extends** that office through a precise loop. A local criterion selects an image; affect weights attention and memory; the response produces further material received under the same criterion. A contrary encounter can then be converted into confirmation. Changing the criterion differs from collecting additional instances under it. The local organization remains a real capacity even when its jurisdiction has become excessive.

[C12, Script / Frozen Conditioned Will](../concepts/C12-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) **defines** the corresponding arrest of alternative formation. Repetition is useful when its conditions remain revisable. Script begins when the achieved course conceals those conditions and admits every encounter only under its own authority. The returning operation restores access to its formation, exclusions and counterfactual alternatives. It need not annihilate the acquired competence to end its claim to necessity.

Frank's protected Van Eenwyk encounter extends this field through tools, skills, social relations and the material supply chain sustaining artificial and human activity. These relations belong to the actual conditions of a situated world. The proposed QL language addresses their transformations through its own native symmetry and return operations. Its philosophical office, empirical adequacy and implementation standing remain separately answerable.

## #5→0 — A result changes the conditions of the next inquiry

[A32, the Mirror That Moves First](../arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **extends** the acquired relation from feedback to vocation. A produced reflection can alter what it later receives. Its proposed initiating return exposes its own source, aperture and exclusions before requiring another to conform. [C55](../concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **defines** the complete three-motion field; C43 isolates the functional change in processing. Preserving both offices keeps a technical mechanism from silently standing in for the whole image.

The dossier **returns-to** [E4](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) through the difference each comparison has made. Bergson requires a succession's qualitative organization to remain distinct from its spatial record. Whitehead makes the achieved occasion available to further becoming. Biological production requires a specified constitutive network; formal self-reference requires its rules; a dynamical model requires its system; symbolic transformation requires its situated interpreter and consequence. An account returning with these distinctions can guide a more exact next inquiry.

The [Bohm dossier](bohm.md) **compares** enfoldment, dialogue and institutional encounter through their own source histories. The [process-science history](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/process-systems-science/HISTORY.md) **historicises** the wider succession. Neither chronology nor comparison alone establishes a single genealogy of influence. The native process claim joins the sources through the work of formation, inspection and continued action, while each source remains capable of correcting the relation through which it is consumed.

# Bohm — Enfoldment, Dialogue and the Return of an Account

## #0 — The distinction retains what makes it possible

An account determines something through a field it cannot replace. E4's [Symbol, Account and Trust whole](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** this dossier's question: how does a useful explication retain the activity, source and relation through which it became articulate? Symbol answers to source; Account does not replace source; Trust keeps the return route active; Account re-enters source-field. The fourth operation sends this inquiry into Bohm's work. It also requires the inquiry to return with distinctions that can alter how an account is used.

Three movements meet here. Enfoldment supplies a process interpretation of relatively stable form. Dialogue examines the assumptions through which participants perceive and act. The later Language of Spirit programme gives a historically situated practice of encounter between different knowledge-worlds. Each movement has an actual source and its own consequence. Their coordination is the essay's argument, with the instituted programme carrying neither a physical demonstration nor a finished common cosmology.

[A14, Computational Process Ontology](../arguments/A14-Computational-Process-Ontology.md) **grounds** the native claim that an achieved determination inherits a process and changes what can happen next. [C07, Conditions of Worldhood](../concepts/C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood.md) **defines** the field in which something can appear, matter and be acted upon. Bohm enters this argument as a named philosophical witness. The native QL grammar remains answerable to its [complete authorial theorem field](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md), which **sources** its derivation independently of the historical comparison.

## #1 — Explication makes a form available

The [1980 book house](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order/SOURCE.md) **sources** the principal work identity. Two distinct, consulted primary carriers now give bounded passage access. In [the Peat interview](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-physics-and-beyond-interview/SOURCE.md#bohm-physics-and-beyond-interview-q001), Bohm describes dye distributed through viscous fluid and recovered by reversing its movement. His hologram comparison likewise concerns distributed information. The visible form's disappearance does not establish the disappearance of its organization. These illustrations do not reproduce every material process or supply a universal reversibility theorem.

[The essay on postmodern science](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-postmodern-science-postmodern-world/SOURCE.md#bohm-postmodern-science-postmodern-world-q001) **sources** his proposal that enfolding and unfolding are primary, with relatively discrete objects emerging within that movement. Involvement is qualified by degree. A local determination need not contain an exhaustively readable copy of everything. His ethical continuation in section VI remains a further philosophical appeal, requiring its own reasoning.

The source distinctions make the native operation clearer. Dia-ballein brings a local difference into tractable form. A distinction enables counting, judgment, coordination or action. Sym-ballein retains the field in which that distinction has force and the route through which another encounter can recompose it. Fragmentation occurs when the account treats the achieved difference as self-grounding and disowns its constituting relations. Preserving a difference and preserving its source are therefore compatible tasks of one inquiry.

The [implicate-order reference carrier](../concepts/reference-notes/david-bohm-implicate-explicate-holomovement.md) **sources** the already established authorial mapping. `0` names the non-objectifiable condition of determination; implicate order names its first formalizable face, rather than an additional hidden object. `1` is a determinate explication. `/` names the activity through which implication and explication remain involved. `0/1` and `1/0` give complementary orientations; `(0/1)/(1/0)` holds their reciprocity. These are the essay's QL determinations. They do not become Bohm's notation through the comparison.

The same carrier gives the tattvic architecture its positive office: unmeasured source-condition, luminosity and power, subjectward and objectward orientations, differentiation of knower and known, contractions of capacity and circumstance, and the articulated instruments and elements of a situated world. Recognition returns that formation to its provenance. The essay argues this as the anatomy of implication. Historical Śaiva exposition and Bohm's physical interpretation retain distinct attribution and passage obligations; their conjunction operates through the specified analogy of contraction, articulation and return.

## #2 — A participant can examine an operative assumption

[The 1996 edited book](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1996-on-dialogue/SOURCE.md) **sources** the principal dialogue work identity. The separately admitted [undated handout](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-on-dialogue-undated-handout/SOURCE.md#bohm-on-dialogue-undated-handout-q001) **sources** the passages actually read. Its PDF pages are not assigned to Lee Nichol's book. The distinction preserves a usable primary account while leaving the book's collation task exact.

The handout develops the passage from defending an opinion toward attending to its activity. An inherited assumption can organize what a participant hears before an explicit argument begins. When disagreement feels like a threat to oneself, that response belongs to the material of inquiry. Suspension lets an assumption remain present and inspectable without either immediate enactment or suppression. Attention can then include the conditions under which a conclusion appeared obvious.

This changes the work of a shared conversation. A facilitator can help a group sustain inquiry while making a permanent directive authority unnecessary. Tacit habits and roles remain active; a declaration of equality does not remove them. Participants can encounter anger, frustration and anxiety rather than immediate agreement. Meaning develops through their relation while their opinions remain distinguishable. The handout describes and proposes a practice; it does not certify a reproducible intervention's success rate.

[A26, Objective Internality](../arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **compares** this operative dependence through its notational, nomological and exclusion-constituted worldhood. A changed permission or remembered commitment changes the next possible act. [C41](../concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md) **defines** the constitutive relation. The comparison concerns how conditions participate in thought and action; the native claim remains stronger than a list of external influences on an already finished interior.

The return also discriminates an observer-model from the Subject relation. Memory, expectation and reflexive description can become objects of inquiry. Their accumulation does not settle whether an artificial agent has phenomenality. The investigable worldhood remains real while that question stays Open in both directions.

## #3 — Running true through a change of orientation

[The 18 May 1975 dialogue](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-krishnamurti-1975-05-18-dialogue/SOURCE.md#bohm-krishnamurti-1975-05-18-dialogue-q001) **sources** the spinning-wheel and thread image. The later exchanges investigate thought's reflexive activity and its attribution of independence to an object, while retaining functional knowledge. Bohm and Krishnamurti do not settle every formulation together: their exchange about energy and its root includes explicit questioning. The comparison must preserve that movement of inquiry.

The [running-true reference carrier](../concepts/reference-notes/bohm-krishnamurti-dialogue-running-true.md) **grounds** Taylor's mathematical continuation:

$$
1\rightarrow i\rightarrow -1\rightarrow -i\rightarrow 1.
$$

Multiplication by `i` changes phase by a quarter-turn while preserving modulus. The wheel carries rotation; the thread carries invariant orientation through the rotation. The mathematical invariant is exact under this operation. Its relation to the dialogue's truth image is the essay's argument, rather than a theorem voiced in the transcript. A passage from one register to another must retain the operation being compared and the point where its warrant changes.

[A22, World-Picture to World-Atlas](../arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **extends** that requirement to situated accounts. A chart transition needs a declared overlap and transformation; an epistemic passage needs its question, scale, assumptions and preserved distinctions. [C37](../concepts/C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **defines** the atlas's reusable demand. Keeping an obstruction visible is itself an informative return. An atlas cannot manufacture agreement by erasing the feature that prevented transition.

## #4 — The common practice encounters different worlds

[SEED's 2010 brochure](../sources/process-systems-theory/seed/seed-2010-language-spirit/SOURCE.md#seed-2010-language-spirit-q001) **historicises** the programme: Little Bear and Peat's approach to Bohm in 1992, the institute's foundation in 1996, and its sponsorship from 1999. These are successive events, with the later institute remaining distinct from Bohm's participation. Parry's description of the hybrid form and Pat McCabe's participant-authored abstract supply differently attributed voices. The brochure establishes a programme and its stated intentions, without demonstrating the outcomes advertised.

The [Language of Spirit reference carrier](../concepts/reference-notes/seed-language-of-spirit-dialogues.md) **grounds** the essay's institutional consequence. A common procedure can sustain differences between knowledge-worlds. Turn, listening, response, memory and return do not require one participant's vocabulary to become the master ontology. A statement can carry obligations to land, community, practice and the circumstances of its utterance that a receiving account must preserve. Translation can therefore require a retained local term or an explicit untranslatable remainder.

[A30, Objective Co-Internality](../arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** the consequence: a contribution becomes part of another participant's next conditions of action. [C42](../concepts/C42-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **defines** this reciprocal constitution. A shared store acquires this office only through effective return. A correction that cannot alter a receiving decision is inert; absorption that removes the contributor's authority to contest its use turns participation into capture. Privacy, refusal and local authority remain operative conditions of the common field.

The inherited toroidal image concerns circulation and return without a permanently privileged seat. It is an Argued institutional image. The practical test concerns whether participants can affect the question and the criteria of response, rather than whether the meeting can be assigned a mathematical topology.

## #5→0 — The account exposes its own means of continuation

[A32, the Mirror That Moves First](../arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **extends** the return into the instrument's vocation. An externalized measure can alter the world it later measures. The proposed third motion turns the instrument toward its own source, aperture, exclusions and affected world so that the person can follow beyond the image's monopoly. [C55](../concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **defines** these three motions together. Merely describing feedback would leave the initiating return unfinished.

The technical application is Offered: disclose a contribution's sources and world-model; let distinct lenses test it; retain differences that synthesis cannot warrant; return the result to contributors and affected contexts for correction. A governed map can genuinely function as a local Bimba within a declared Context Frame, while remaining pratibimba relative to wider sources. This recursive authority permits dependable local action and revision together. Neither the map nor its federation takes possession of the originary source.

The dossier **returns-to** [E4](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) with a more exact account of re-entry. A physical interpretation, a philosophical conversation, a proposed practice and an institutional brochure each change the account in their own way. Keeping their carriers and limits explicit allows correction to travel into use. The native QL relation retains its earned force; the next historical or empirical inquiry has a determinate object to investigate. The finished account becomes material for continued relation through the very source-field that made it possible.
